learning_objective: 🎯 Let us follow the fascinating journey of how fluffy cotton and warm wool turn into the beautiful clothes we wear!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Our clothes start as tiny fibers that come from nature. We get fluffy cotton from plants and warm wool from gentle sheep!
These tiny fibers are twisted together tightly to make long threads. Then, special machines weave these threads over and under each other to make a large piece of cloth.
Once the cloth is ready and dyed in beautiful colors, a tailor cuts it into special shapes and sews the pieces together to make a shirt, dress, or pants!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Wardrobe Detective!
fun_activity.instructions: Look inside your closet and check the little tags on your clothes to see if you can find one made of 100 percent cotton and one made of wool!

quick_recap: ⭐ Natural clothes are made from fibers we get from wonderful plants and animals.
⭐ Spinning turns loose fibers into strong threads, and weaving turns threads into fabric.
⭐ Tailors and factories sew the soft fabrics into the comfortable clothes we wear every day.
